subject: Request: One-time POC Bridge & Complimentary Credits for HelioHealth
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: One-time POC Bridge & Complimentary Credits for HelioHealth

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Quick ask — HelioHealth (Sophie Lam, Timothy Cho) is mid-integration with our sandbox but hit a blocker in data volume testing. Their procurement cycle is out to the end of August; they’re asking for a 30-day POC extension and ~60k complimentary token credit to finish the integration and run end-to-end clinical workload tests.

Context: HelioHealth is a targeted mid-market account in health-tech; technical team is seeing quality signals and wants to validate latency/cost at scale before signing a 1-year Dedicated contract. If we grant a one-time bridge (beyond standard PLG limits of 14 days / 10k tokens), they’ll commit to PO + security review kickoff within 30 days of the extended POC finish and we’ll get a joint case study.

Requested concession (one-time):
- 30 day POC extension (start upon approval)
- 60,000 complimentary generation tokens (applied as sandbox credit)

Attached: Helio_POC_SOW.pdf (POC plan + acceptance criteria) and a usage snapshot from their trial so far.

Can you advise Deal Desk stance and whether this needs CRO/CEO sign-off? Time-sensitive — customer is pushing to start the extended run by Monday.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time POC Bridge & Complimentary Credits for HelioHealth

Jordan —

Thanks for the write-up and the SOW. A few quick clarifying questions before I escalate:
1) Do we have an explicit acceptance criteria signed by Helio that ties to a PO or commitment? (SOW shows success metrics but no signature)
2) Is there an expected ARR if they convert post-POC?
3) Are they open to a phased concession (smaller credit + opt-in quantization recommendations) to reduce cost exposure?

Given the ask (60k tokens / 30 days) this is outside standard PLG concessions. I’ll flag to Aditya for exec approval but please confirm the answers above so we can include them in the approval note.

Also: procurement has asked for an updated Milestone + Deliverables doc — can you push an annotated SOW to Sophie and cc procurement?

Cheers,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-17T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time POC Bridge & Complimentary Credits for HelioHealth

Marissa — answering inline: 
1) Acceptance: Sophie verbally agreed to the SOW and email thread (see quoted exchange below), procurement requested the signed doc only after successful run; they’ll sign a PO contingent on successful acceptance criteria.
2) Expected ARR: initial ask is for a 1.2M ARR for Dedicated deployment in year one (commercial pipeline attached in HubSpot deal).
3) Phased concession: customer prefers a single uplift to avoid repeated interruptions; they asked for full runway.

Customer urgency: they can’t validate model behavior with current token limits — the live dataset they need to exercise will take ~45k tokens across several runs.

Given the opportunity and conversion probability, this feels strategic and time-sensitive. Asking Aditya / Grace for one-time discretionary sign-off. If approved, I’ll push an annotated SOW and DocuSign link to Sophie and procurement this afternoon.

Quoted from Sophie (7/15):
> Jordan — thank you. If we can get an extended sandbox and one-time credit to complete the data spike, we’ll move procurement to PO. Our CTO wants to see the cost/latency profile on the full dataset.

Jordan

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time POC Bridge & Complimentary Credits for HelioHealth

Team —

I reviewed the context and SOW. HelioHealth looks like a high-probability mid-market opportunity with a clear conversion path and defined ARR assumptions. I’m comfortable approving a constrained, conditional concession but want to reduce open exposure. Approved terms (one-time, non-precedent setting):
- 45,000 complimentary generation tokens (applied to their sandbox account; no auto-renew)
- 21-day POC extension (starts on customer acceptance of the DocuSign SOW)
- Condition: Signed PO or formal procurement intent within 30 days of extension end OR a written opt-in to move to a paid sandbox subscription that covers baseline usage.
- Marketing condition: customer agrees to a joint case study if they convert within 90 days post-POC (redacted technical details ok).

Marissa — please document these in Deal Desk and flag the concession as "one-off: exec-approved". Jordan — push the DocuSign and confirm acceptance in-thread with Sophie.

Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales Strategy & Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lam <sophie.lam@heliohealth.com>

Date: 2028-07-20T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: One-time POC Bridge & Complimentary Credits for HelioHealth

Sophie / Timothy — great news: Redwood has approved a one-time sandbox concession to help finish your integration testing. Summary of approved terms below (Aditya approved):
- 45,000 complimentary generation tokens (sandbox credit applied)
- 21-day extension to your sandbox environment, to begin once you accept the attached SOW via DocuSign
- Condition: Please provide a signed PO or procurement intent within 30 days after the extension ends, or opt into our paid sandbox subscription to cover baseline usage.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached an annotated SOW for signature. Please sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-helio-poc
2) Procurement: if you want the PO template filled, reply to procurement@heliohealth.com and I’ll loop our legal to expedite.
3) We’ll provision the extended sandbox and credit within 24 hours of DocuSign completion.

Appreciate the partnership — we’re excited to get you fully validated on Redwood.

Best,
Jordan
